svg.aria-label: m10dis decode exchange: multicast request, card sums, return slots and acknowledgements
svg.text: One MoE layer at decode (mode 1): request, card sums, return, acknowledgements
RTX page table: 4 × 4 KiB per card
remapped onto that card's multicast window
slot = 20 B header + one FP32 row of 2560 (10,260 B)
no PCIe reads in a session
the RTX's link carries 6 requests + 6 rows
PEX8748 · the PLX board on the CPU x16 slot
ACS request/completion redirect cleared on the RTX and M10 ports (saved and restored per session)
publish: one posted write per card; the card's PEX8747 copies it to its 4 GPUs (multicast: only posted writes are replicated)
compute: each routed GPU runs its 32-of-640-row slices of the 10 chosen experts; card 5's GPUs run the shared expert
card sum: the 3 peers push their partial rows into the leader's BAR1 and set a flag; the leader adds own + peers in fixed order
return: each leader writes its card sum into its slot in RTX VRAM (worker page table: 3 × 4 KiB remapped onto RTX BAR1)
acknowledge: all 24 workers write seq last into their own slot, also on an error exit (status = 1 + exit bits)
combine: the RTX sees 24 acks in its own VRAM and sums 6 rows. ② to ⑤ ≈ 132 µs, whole layer ≈ 150 µs
